rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose Cantonese noun for an eraser.

example.english: I wrote the character wrong, so I used a rubber to correct it.
example.traditional: 我寫錯字，攞塊擦膠改返佢。
example.jyutping: ngo5 se2 co3 zi6 lo2 faai3 caat3 gaau1 goi2 faan1 keoi5

rows.note: Use this everyday term for a condom, especially an external condom.

example.english: Before doing that, remember to wear a rubber.
example.traditional: 做嗰樣嘢之前，記住戴安全套。
example.jyutping: zou6 go2 joeng6 je5 zi1 cin4 gei3 zyu6 daai3 on1 cyun4 tou3

rows.note: Use this when rubber means a vehicle tire, including a racing tire in context.

example.english: The rubber tire is flat and needs replacing.
example.traditional: 條車胎漏氣，要換新嘅喇。
example.jyutping: tiu4 ce1 taai1 lau6 hei3 jiu3 wun6 san1 ge3 laa3

rows.note: Use this for the natural material from rubber-tree sap rather than for a manufactured rubber item.

example.english: This factory uses natural rubber to make gloves.
example.traditional: 呢間廠用天然橡膠整手套。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 cong2 jung6 tin1 jin4 zoeng6 gaau1 zing2 sau2 tou3
